name: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited
summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited, a metal-producing company, produces and sells long steel products, ferro alloys, and aluminium and stainless steel in India and internationally. The company offers carbon steel products, such as pellet, sponge and pig iron, billet, TMT bar, structural bar, structural steel, wire rods, and crash barrier; SS rebar, hot rolled bar, bright bar, wires, welding wires, and wire rod, as well as stainless steel billets; and flat, pipe, and hollow section products. It also provides battery and bare aluminum foils, fin stock, and kitchen foil range.
